# Screen Reader Only (SrOnly)

Visually hides content while keeping it accessible to screen readers.

## When to Use

- Adding context for screen reader users
- Skip links
- Form instructions that are visually implied
- Icon-only buttons that need text labels

## Jumpstart Implementation

| Jumpstart Component | Description |
|---------------------|-------------|
| `SrOnly` | Visually hidden but accessible content |
